comment:
The manual lists only External clock and Reset among the inputs. The module also has Start and Stop inputs, which the panel labels RUN and STOP (Sync.cpp:73-74, 131-140). If both fire on the same sample, Stop wins (Sync.cpp:133-140).

The module comes up running (Sync.cpp:54), which the manual does not say.

While EXT is patched the tempo knob does nothing: the outputs are driven straight from the incoming edges (Sync.cpp:160-202). The displayed BPM is measured from the interval, smoothed by a fifth of the difference each edge, accepted only between 20 and 400 BPM, and dropped again if no edge arrives for eight periods (Sync.cpp:166-175, 200-203).

In external mode the double-speed output fires its extra pulse half an external period after each edge, so it lags the tempo by one beat after a change (Sync.cpp:186-198).
